name: Elemental Aegis
description:
You draw upon the raw elemental forces of Athas to protect yourself. For the duration, you have resistance to one damage type of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. Additionally, when a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction to deal 1d6 damage of the chosen type to the attacker.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
